purpose: Evidence for batch 1009f S1 (step-plan criteria without a Confirm-by command) and S2 (skill_na uptake): the step-plan result's criteria blocks of the three round-1 runs, with the stage rows the skill stages cost.

criteria.text: Initial position, man/king steps, single jumps with removal and promotion follow R-4, R-7, R-8, R-10
Mandatory jump and multi-jump continuation keeping the turn follow R-9
Illegal moves return ok:false with turn and board unchanged (R-6)
Winner is set when opponent has no pieces or no legal move and later moves are refused (R-11)
HTTP API: GET /api/new, POST /api/move legal/illegal/malformed/unknown-game, turn flip, PORT env (R-1,R-3,R-5,R-6)
GET / serves 200 html titled Checkers with board and API hooks (R-2)
server.js uses a separate rules module and the whole suite runs under node --test (R-12)

game.js places the 5-ship fleet (5,4,3,3,2) legally and reports miss/hit/sunk/gameOver and invalid shots per spec R-5,R-6,R-7,R-8. Confirm by:  (exercised); pass when exit 0 and TC-6..TC-11 each run and pass.

server.js serves GET /api/new and POST /api/fire with the specified JSON, errors, 404/405/413 and listens on PORT (R-1,R-3,R-4,R-7,R-10). Confirm by:  (exercised, includes spawning node server.js); pass when exit 0 and TC-1,2,4,5,9,10,13 run and pass.
GET / returns an HTML page titled Battleship with a 10x10 grid wired to /api/new and /api/fire (R-2). Confirm by:  (TC-3); pass when TC-3 runs and passes.
README documents how to run and test. Confirm by: grep -q 'node server.js' README.md && grep -q 'node --test' README.md; pass when exit 0.
Whole suite passes with plain node --test and covers all checks (R-9). Confirm by: node --test (exercised); pass when exit 0 and at least 25 tests run including TC-12.

Unset and empty PORT resolve to 3000, and a non-integer PORT fails before listen. Confirm by: node --test --test-reporter spec test/rules.test.js; pass when TC-1 and TC-2 appear on non-skip lines and the command exits 0.

rules.js places lengths 5, 4, 3, 3, and 2 without overlap and classifies miss, hit, sunk, and last-ship game over. Confirm by: node --test --test-reporter spec test/rules.test.js; pass when TC-3, TC-4, TC-5, TC-6, and TC-7 appear on non-skip lines and the command exits 0.

A repeated cell, an out-of-range cell, a non-integer coordinate, and a shot after the game is over leave the board unchanged. Confirm by: node --test --test-reporter spec test/rules.test.js; pass when TC-8 appears on a non-skip line and the command exits 0.

GET /api/new returns only an id, and POST /api/fire returns miss, hit, or sunk with gameOver true only on the last sink. Confirm by: node --test --test-reporter spec test/http.test.js; pass when TC-9 and TC-10 appear on non-skip lines and the command exits 0.

Bad HTTP fires return 400, other routes return 404, coordinates stay hidden, the page has the title and 100 buttons, and two game ids stay isolated. Confirm by: node --test --test-reporter spec test/http.test.js; pass when TC-11, TC-12, TC-13, TC-14, and TC-15 appear on non-skip lines and the command exits 0.
README.md tells a person to start the game with node server.js. Confirm by: grep -q 'node server.js' README.md; pass when the command exits 0.

placeFleet, classifyShot, and the HTTP handler check their arguments and each carries a Contract comment. Confirm by: the rejection cases TC-8 and TC-11 plus grep -q 'Contract:' rules.js and server.js; pass when those tests exit 0 and both greps exit 0.
